about.cardDesc: A public, community-owned, not-for-profit educational institution registered in Kanchanrup, Saptari, Nepal. Built in 2013 to bridge educational disparities.
about.headline: A Not-For-Profit Educational Beacon within a 30-Kilometer Radius.
about.story:
Welcome to Roopnagar Nandaraj Sangraula Campus (RNS Campus), a public college nestled in the heart of Roopnagar, Saptari district, in the Terai region of Nepal. Established in 2013 as a not-for-profit community-owned college, RNS Campus is committed to providing quality education and empowering students from diverse backgrounds.

Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, Nepal's oldest and largest university, RNS Campus offers a Bachelor of Business Studies program. The college strives to deliver an excellent academic experience while fostering personal growth and professional development among its students.

RNS Campus plays a crucial role in the local community, particularly for students hailing from poor family backgrounds in the rural Terai region of Nepal. Given financial constraints and limited opportunities, thousands of students from poor and marginalized communities are compelled to pursue their higher education in local colleges. RNS Campus is the sole community-owned, not-for-profit college within a 30-kilometer radius catering specifically to Bachelor's Degree programs in Management.
about.infraDesc: We believe that a conducive environment is key to learning. We continually invest in our physical facilities to support our curriculum.
about.smartClassDesc: Our classrooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and equipped with smart boards and audio-visual setups. This supports dynamic discussions and interactive TU curriculum delivery.
about.computerLabDesc: Our computer lab provides desktop systems, internet access, and data analysis software. It serves first-year literacy modules and research data entries.
about.vision: To emerge as a center of educational excellence, producing efficient, competent, and ethical graduates equipped with essential life-skills to lead Saptari and the Terai region of Nepal towards economic and social development.
about.mission: To provide accessible, affordable, and high-quality higher education, foster research capabilities, and empower students from marginalized backgrounds through holistic academic and practical skill development.
about.goals:
1. Expand undergraduate academic offerings.
2. Strengthen digital & computer laboratory facilities.
3. Provide 100% scholarship coverage to deserving underprivileged and female students.
4. Build partnerships with national research bodies and local governments.

academics.bbsDesc: Our four-year academic course follows the Tribhuvan University syllabus, introducing students to organizational theory, finance, business administration, marketing, and human resource management.

bbsYears.title: Advanced Studies

chairmanMessage.name: Giriraj Sangraula
chairmanMessage.quote: "A place where knowledge flourishes and dreams find their wings."
chairmanMessage.body:
Dear Members of the RNS Campus Community,

I extend to you a warm and heartfelt welcome to Roopnagar Nandaraj Sangraula Campus (RNS Campus), a place where knowledge flourishes and dreams find their wings. It is an honor to lead this institution, which stands as a beacon of learning and opportunity in the heart of Roopnagar, Saptari district.

Since our inception in 2013, RNS Campus has been steadfast in its dedication to offering not only quality education but also a transformative experience to students from all walks of life. Affiliated to the esteemed Tribhuvan University, we proudly offer the Bachelor of Business Studies program.

Our vision is clear and our resolve unshaken: we are dedicated to transforming RNS Campus into a hub of educational excellence. Join us as we build a brighter future for Saptari and beyond.

chiefMessage.name: Prof. Deepak Gajurel
chiefMessage.quote: "Since our establishment in 2013, RNS Campus has held its commitment to providing exceptional education."
chiefMessage.body:
Warm greetings to all visitors, academic seekers, and well-wishers,

At Roopnagar Nandaraj Sangraula Campus, we take immense pride in delivering the 4-Year Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) program under Tribhuvan University, enriched with modern skill-enhancement modules tailored to regional requirements.

Recognizing that theoretical knowledge alone is insufficient in today's competitive landscape, our curriculum is paired with intensive hands-on workshops in basic computing, academic writing, data editing, research methodology, and financial literacy.

Our dedicated faculty members work tirelessly to maintain rigorous academic standards, personalized mentorship, and inclusive learning environments. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur, financial analyst, public administrator, or social researcher, RNS Campus is your springboard to success.

chronicles.title: क्षेत्रीय विकासमा सामुदायिक क्याम्पसको भूमिका: सप्तरीको सन्दर्भ
chronicles.excerpt: सप्तरी जिल्लामा उच्च शिक्षाको पहुँच वृद्धि गर्न र स्थानीय युवाहरूलाई स्वरोजगार बनाउन रूपनगर क्याम्पसको भूमिकाबारे विश्लेषण...
chronicles.author: By BBS 4th Year Research Team
fullContent: नेपालको तराई-मधेश भूभागमा स्थित सप्तरी जिल्ला सामाजिक तथा आर्थिक विकासको दृष्टिले अझै पनि चुनौतीपूर्ण अवस्थामा रहेको छ। स्थानीय स्तरमा सुलभ र गुणस्तरीय उच्च शिक्षाको पहुँच नपुग्दा ठूलो संख्यामा विपन्न तथा सीमान्तकृत समुदायका युवाहरू उच्च शिक्षा हासिल गर्नबाट बञ्चित हुने वा वैदेशिक रोजगारीमा जान बाध्य हुने परिस्थिति रहँदै आएको छ।

यस्तो संवेदनशील अवस्थामा २०७० सालमा स्थापित रूपनगर नन्दराज संग्रौला क्याम्पसले एक सार्वजनिक तथा नाफारहित सामुदायिक शैक्षिक संस्थाको रूपमा आफ्नो ऐतिहासिक जिम्मेवारी वहन गर्दै आएको छ। ३० किलोमिटरको परिधिभित्र व्यवस्थापन (BBS) तहको स्नातक तह सञ्चालन गर्ने एक मात्र संस्थाको रूपमा यस क्याम्पसले ग्रामीण भेगका विद्यार्थीहरूलाई घरदैलोमै उच्च शिक्षाको ढोका खोलेको छ।

क्याम्पसले केवल सैद्धान्तिक ज्ञानमा सीमित नभई कम्प्युटर साक्षरता, लेखन तथा सम्पादन, र सामाजिक अनुसन्धान जस्ता जीवन उपयोगी सीपहरूलाई पाठ्यक्रममा समावेश गरेको छ। यसले गर्दा उत्पादित स्नातकहरू स्थानीय सहकारी, वित्तीय संस्था, विद्यालय तथा स्थानीय तहका प्रशासनिक निकायहरूमा दक्षताका साथ कार्य गर्न सक्षम भएका छन्।

निष्कर्षमा, रूपनगर क्याम्पसजस्ता सामुदायिक शैक्षिक संस्थाहरूको सुदृढीकरणले मात्र क्षेत्रीय विकास, सामाजिक न्याय र आत्मनिर्भर अर्थतन्त्रको निर्माण सम्भव छ। यसका लागि स्थानीय सरकार, बुद्धिजीवी र सम्पूर्ण जनसमुदायको सहकार्य र सहयोग निरन्तर आवश्यक देखिन्छ।
